about_the_game:
Goblinna's Garden is a relaxed tower defence where you defend your garden from waves of hungry insects! Happy bees will grant pollen to build and upgrade towers. Squashing bugs will grant shovels to add dirt, water, plant more flowers, and even change the path of the insects themselves.

For those worried about it being "insecty", the 'creepy buggy' vibe is absent. Enjoy the concept of bugs, without the bugs!

All maps are randomly generated to allow a unique experience every play. They can be changed dynamically by adding and removing water, ground litter, and dirt. No more static pathing, you can change how the bugs move with the drop of a shovel and raising the dirt!

A great intro for those learning tower defence games, Goblinna's Garden features a simplified UI without lengthy explainers or tutorials. Drop in to the action and watch adorable towers taking on even more adorable garden pests. 

Or, crank up the difficulty on medium, hard, or random mode to truly test your skill against our crawly companions.

short_description: Quick to start, learn, and play tower defence! Use 7 unique towers to squash waves of 10 unique enemy types. Dynamically change the maze by raising and lowering dirt to block off parts of the path. Enjoy endless replayability with map customizers to allow for a personalized tower defence experience!
